### A Good Soldier's Practice
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/good-soldiers-practice
Passage: 2 Timothy 2:3-4
Points:
- Enduring hardship and suffering is an inevitable part of faithfully following Christ.
- Like a dedicated soldier on duty, a believer must avoid worldly entanglements that distract from the mission.
- The supreme goal of the Christian soldier is to please Christ, who enlisted him into service.
- Developing single-minded devotion to God requires daily discipline and reliance on the Holy Spirit.

### Power Point - January 9, 2006
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-january-9-2006-1371861.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 2:1-6
Points:
- Believers must examine their personal contribution to Christ's body in prayer, giving, serving, and witnessing.
- Spiritual strength reveals itself through maturity, stability, authenticity, vitality, integrity, and purity.
- There are no shortcuts to godly servanthood apart from consistent study of Scripture and faithful obedience.
- Followers of Christ should cast aside critical attitudes and cultivate humility and submission.

### Day 318: 2 Timothy 2:1–13
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-318-2-timothy-2-113.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 2:1-13
Points:
- Paul faced extreme physical suffering, harsh chains, and profound isolation during his final imprisonment.
- Despite humiliating circumstances and abandonment by associates, Paul stood firm in his certainty of Christ.
- Although the messenger may be chained like a criminal, God's message cannot be bound.
- Remembering past tokens of God's faithfulness and holding fast to Scripture sustains believers through deep trials.
